lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: Hard hat or off the grade, and I don't care which. We pour at six and the schedule is the schedule.

lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: Four hundred megawatts, they want. I've built three of these and I've never seen a spec ask for that much cooling for a logistics shed.

lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: Ask the camp clerk about the payroll if you want something to lose sleep over. I stopped asking in week nine.

lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: You lot keep looking at the frame like you know what goes in it. If you do, don't tell me at work.
